title: Await
summary: Render deferred values with component-owned loading and error content.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: resolve accepts a value or Promise. children receives Awaited<T>. fallback supplies component-owned pending content; pass null to render nothing. errorElement is optional and may be null on rejection.

sections.title: Pending and resolved values
sections.body: For early hydration, put fallback directly on Await. The server renders ordinary fallback HTML; the existing deferred-data stream delivers the result, and the mounted component updates its own content. No streamed Suspense DOM is inserted. Preserve the promise identity between renders.

sections.title: Rejections
sections.body: When errorElement is supplied, Await renders it instead of children. Otherwise the rejection is thrown during rendering and must be handled by a Preact error boundary. useRouteError reads router request errors; it does not expose this locally handled promise rejection.

sections.title: Server rendering
sections.body: Await starts no requests. With earlyHydration enabled, an explicit fallback is rendered and hydrated normally; promise settlements update only mounted components. Deferred results are sent as data, not resolved HTML, so JavaScript is required to replace these fallbacks. Ordinary SSR without early hydration still streams resolved HTML. Returning resolved data renders immediately. Route-data HTTP transport continues to resolve promises before serialization.

sections.title: Existing Suspense usage
sections.body: Await without a fallback retains its existing Suspense behavior. Published Preact 11.0.1 can retain abandoned fallback nodes when native streamed Suspense is hydrated before settlement. For early hydration, replace the outer Suspense with Await fallback on each deferred section, including persistent root sections. This integrated path needs no dependency patch or separate import. It does not fix arbitrary native Suspense or lazy-component boundaries.
